verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded from the docs site. The documented REST endpoints (job create, read, auth, health) give it a real API surface to describe. missing for 10: first-party docs that link to or describe the spec, and evidence that it fully covers the v2 jobs endpoints (e.g., webhooks, SSE, uploads).
